method: All300 PCM translations read and compared with corresponding English reference and canonical Korean context read during AF/TL authoring. Full quoted passages, English targets, meaning glosses, numbers, person/age relations, negation, hints and answers considered. Surface checks are supplementary.
independence: Reviewer did not author PCM; reviewer authored corresponding AF/TL texts, so not blind review. AI review, not native-speaker/teacher approval.

notableChecks.1125: Target correctly preserves canonical next month rather than English reference in a month.
notableChecks.1139: Target correctly preserves do not like rather than weaker reference not favorite.
notableChecks.1151: Target correctly avoids equating not happy with sad.
notableChecks.1166: Target correctly avoids equating not tall with short.
notableChecks.1288: Target correctly retains did homework without requiring reference finished.
notableChecks.gender: Existing names do not supply gender evidence. Native wording uses names/e where suitable; English pronoun target text retained as source learning material.
